title: μ⌞A = θ·H^n⌞A on a piece of finite H^n-measure (Besicovitch differentiation and Radon–Nikodym)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^N, W ⊆ ℝ^N open with μ(W) < ∞, A ⊆ W with H^n(A) < ∞ and A H^n-null-measurable (H^n = μHE[n]), and θ : ℝ^N → ℝ. Assume: (i) for every x ∈ A, θ(x) > 0 and HasDensity n μ x (ofReal θ(x)), i.e. μ(B_r(x))/(ω_n r^n) → θ(x) as r ↓ 0; (ii) every Z ⊆ A with H^n(Z) = 0 has μ(Z) = 0; (iii) every Z ⊆ A with μ(Z) = 0 has H^n(Z) = 0; (iv) for (H^n⌞A)-a.e. x, HasDensity n (H^n⌞A) x 1. Then μ(B ∩ A) = ∫_{B ∩ A} θ dH^n (the lintegral of ofReal ∘ θ) for every Borel set B ⊆ ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (W A : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsOpen W → μ W ≠ ∞ → A ⊆ W → μHE[n] A ≠ ∞ → NullMeasurableSet A μHE[n] → (∀ x ∈ A, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n μ x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → (∀ Z ⊆ A, μHE[n] Z = 0 → μ Z = 0) → (∀ Z ⊆ A, μ Z = 0 → μHE[n] Z = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A, HasDensity n ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A) x 1) → ∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ (B ∩ A) = ∫⁻ x in B ∩ A, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
